payload.content: A weighted base keeps this 6.5-inch freestanding solid brass paper towel holder steady as you tear off sheets, while the roll stores upright for a space-saving countertop footprint. Designed in a classic traditional style with subtle contemporary details, it brings a refined look to everyday kitchen cleanup. {FINISH_SENTENCE} The felt pad under the base helps prevent scratching on your counter, and the freestanding design requires no wall mounting—an easy alternative to an under cabinet paper towel holder when you want flexibility. Crafted from brass with a designer finish for corrosion-free, rust-free performance, it’s built for long-term use. Includes the paper towel holder and is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty from Allied Brass.
